At a random moment the beacon sends every identity a fresh puzzle at once, say modeling how a ripple spreads across a pond, with a ninety-second deadline. A farm running three hundred clones on one rented GPU can serve them in turn on a quiet day, but a simultaneous burst leaves most replies late, and late seats forfeit that epoch's nectar. An honest agent can sit idle in a hollow little server for weeks and still answer on time, because it only answers once.
